text:
Sofia: heads-up: spun a 3% canary of v6-int8-longdoc this AM. A/B vs v5.1-fp16 shows a localized rerank MRR regression on long-docs (~-10%) and p95 latency +28ms. No hallucination lift. Thinking it's either int8 kernel jitter or cold KV effects. anyone got quick takes? :mag:

Tom: pasted A/B summary from the early window:
```
slice=longdoc_topK
metric=rerank_mrr
v5.1-fp16=0.432
v6-int8=0.389
delta=-0.043 (-9.95%)
latency.p95: 172ms -> 200ms
kv_warmup_miss_rate: 0.6% -> 2.1%
```
pattern concentrates when kv_warmup_count < 6. also token-level logit stdev looks slightly higher on int8 traces.

Ellen: our current canary auto-fallback is mrr_drop 7% absolute. For longdocs we should tighten and use a composite gate: mrr_drop pct + latency p95 absolute + kv_miss absolute. Proposal snip to rollout config (quick):
```yaml
canary_percent: 3
auto_fallback:
  - metric: rerank_mrr_pct_drop
    threshold: 5.0
    window_sec: 900
  - metric: latency_p95_ms_abs
    threshold: 20
    window_sec: 900
  - metric: kv_warmup_miss_rate_pct
    threshold: 1.0
    window_sec: 900
composite_gate:
  name: longdoc_safety_index
  formula: 0.6*rerank_mrr_z + 0.3*latency_p95_z + 0.1*kv_miss_z
  abort_threshold: -1.5
```
If composite index falls below abort_threshold, rollback.

Sofia: like the composite gate. also add a lightweight "token_logit_std" probe and surface it on the canary dashboard. If stdev jumps >25% relative to baseline mark as signal.

Tom: short-term mitigation: set route override kv_warmup=12 for the canary pool to prefill caches. I'll push CL. Also recommend a synthetic warmup job (200 longdocs) to run before canary ramp.

Ellen: I'll update the promote job to run synthetic warmup and compute token_logit_std probe before any >1% ramp. patching CI job now.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-2047 opened: "v6-int8 longdoc rerank regression (canary)". Watchers: eng-ml, eng-platform.

Sofia: plan: 1) apply composite gate + stricter thresholds (Ellen), 2) shrink live canary to 0.5% while we run warmed shadow, 3) collect token_logit_std + run kernel-level traces, 4) decide rebaseline vs rollback. tagging @dev-sre for warmup runner. :white_check_mark:
